thread:
nora.sales: POC customer reports assistant "loses" system prompt after they POST full session + attachments. Client shows `413 Payload Too Large` then `400 max_input_tokens exceeded` on retry.

diego.eng: Can you share the raw gateway line?

nora.sales: gateway-us: `client=198.51.100.22 request=\"POST /v1/chat\" content_length=4587230 status=413` and runtime: `reject: sequence_length 19200 > max 16384 org=org_YQ`. They send last 80 turns + 6 screenshots base64.

samira-sre: Two failure layers: gateway body limit (~2MB) -> 413, and runtime token cap (16384) -> 400. Retries compound the problem.

leo-ps: Customer insists on sending raw turns to avoid behavior drift. They also asked about security/retention for presigned URLs vs inline images in case files leave the org.

diego.eng: Short fixes to propose now: (1) Upload attachments to our /v1/files endpoint or S3 presigned URLs and reference URLs in messages. (2) Enable `Content-Encoding: gzip` for the JSON body. (3) Use SDK `truncate: \"tail\"` and `max_input_tokens: 8192`. (4) Implement a small client-side summarizer for older turns.

samira-sre: On retention/security: presigned URLs are short-lived and do not persist on our side unless they upload via /v1/files which stores per-org with ACLs and retention policies. We'll need to share our file retention SLAs for the security questionnaire. storage-bot: please attach retention doc?

storage-bot: attached: docs/retention/presigned-urls-vs-files-2025-02.pdf :paperclip: (link)

leo-ps: For POC escalation: we can provision a sandbox with increased gateway limit (6MB) and a dedicated runtime bump to 32k tokens for limited trial. Requires ops ticket + signed addendum and SRE OK. ops-bot: create ticket?

ops-bot: ticket #4092 opened for gateway/runtime bump (org_YQ), status: awaiting-approval :rotating_light:

nora.sales: Customer agreed to sign NDA addendum if it helps. They want to know cost delta if we allow larger contexts.

diego.eng: Rough calc to share: worst-case tokens per call = sequence_cap; estimated cost delta = sequence_cap * calls_per_month * price_per_token. Ask customer for calls/month and average response length. I can run sample numbers.

samira-sre: If we allow larger runtime cap, we must enforce per-request memory guards: max_input_tokens per-call settable and KV/prefix cache enabled to avoid reprocessing long unchanged prefixes. Also disable inline base64 images in the trial.

leo-ps: I'll draft an email bundle: (A) immediate mitigations + SDK param examples, (B) sample summarization snippet, (C) security note on presigned URLs vs /v1/files, (D) pricing ask and ops ticket status.

nora.sales: Can you include a tiny summarization example they can paste?

leo-ps: Sure, short pseudo-code to include:
```
# Summarize older turns then send
history = fetchHistory(session_id)
if len(history) > 12:
  summary = summarize(history[:-12])
  payload = [ {"role":"system","content":summary} ] + history[-12:]
else:
  payload = history
post('/v1/chat', {"messages": payload})
```

ops-bot: ops task #4092 requires SRE sign-off before provisioning. samira-sre: please review memory risk.

samira-sre: Will review today. If approved, sandbox will be time-limited (7 days) and we will enable a runtime guard that returns 429 if `estimated_tokens` > 32768 to protect OOM.

nora.sales: Perfect. I'll send the draft to customer with the retention doc link, summarization snippet, and the pricing question. Meeting scheduled for tomorrow to walk through presigned URL flow. :thumbsup:

diego.eng: One more tip for engineers: multipart upload reduces in-memory buffering at the gateway and helps for large attachments. But it doesn't change token counting in runtime. Mention that in the demo.

leo-ps: Email sent. Customer replied asking for a short example of the `/v1/files` flow and which headers to set for gzip. I'll add that to the demo deck.
